name: Newt
description: For new deployments, our official recommendation is to use the Pangolin Site template which utilizes the Pangolin CLI rather than this template. Newt acts as a tunneled gateway for your local network, enabling seamless zero-trust remote access through the Pangolin (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin) platform. It securely routes traffic to your Unraid services without complex port forwarding or exposure to the public internet. Chat with us on Discord! https://pangolin.net/discord

variables.name: PANGOLIN_ENDPOINT
variables.description: This is the full URL of the Pangolin instance. Example: https://app.pangolin.net

variables.name: NEWT_ID
variables.description: This is the unique ID of the site provided after generation. Example: 31frd0uzbjvp721

variables.name: NEWT_SECRET
variables.description: This is the secret key of the site after generation. Example: h51mmlknrvrwv8s4r1i210azhumt6isgbpyavxodibx1k2d6
